# LifeLine Voice — Emergency Response Command

> Hands-free, real-time emergency first aid assistant powered by speech recognition, Web Audio, and WebMCP agent tools.

LifeLine Voice is an emergency web application engineered to guide bystanders and first responders through life-critical medical emergencies with hands-free voice guidance and WebMCP tool invocation.

## Core Application & Capabilities

- [LifeLine Voice Live Application](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/): Main hands-free emergency response command center and interactive voice interface.
- [WebMCP Agent Interface](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/): Declarative tool context exposing emergency actions and state to autonomous AI agents.
- [Emergency Dispatch Assistance](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/#dispatch): Direct protocol and prompts for alerting European emergency services (112).

## Emergency Protocols

- [CPR / RKO Protocol](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/#cpr): Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guide with 30:2 ratio, 5-6 cm compression depth, and 110 BPM audio metronome.
- [Choking Protocol (Zadławienie)](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/#choking): Step-by-step sequence for 5 back blows followed by 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).
- [Severe Bleeding Control](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/#bleeding): Direct pressure application, sterile packing, wound dressing, and limb elevation guidance.
- [Unconscious Casualty Assessment](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/#unconscious): Airway opening (head-tilt, chin-lift), 10-second respiratory check, and recovery position.

## Exposed WebMCP Agent Tools

- [start_cpr_metronome](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/): Starts a 110 BPM rhythmic audio metronome to guide chest compressions.
- [stop_cpr_metronome](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/): Stops the rhythmic metronome audio cadence.
- [get_emergency_protocol](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/): Returns structured, step-by-step first aid instructions for a specified emergency type (cpr, choking, bleeding, unconscious).
- [call_emergency_services](https://lifeline-command.netlify.app/): Triggers emergency dispatch confirmation dialog to dial 112.

## Optional

- [European Resuscitation Council (ERC) Guidelines](https://www.erc.edu/): International clinical standards and scientific guidelines for resuscitation.
